messages:
alex: Heads-up — hotfix PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9123 needs 2x LGTM before cutoff 18:00 PT. Tests look green locally but integration is flaky on kv-cache. If we don't have 2 approvals by 17:50 we'll execute the rollforward fallback. @maria @cheng can you eyeball?

maria: Looking now, will do a quick review. kv-cache change is tiny (cache key normalization). If I see anything blocking I'll flag within 20m.

cheng: I can take second eyes at 17:30 PT. I'm on call until 18:00 so I can approve if perf checks look OK. Running smoke now.

jonah: If we miss cutoff we should do a staged deploy w/ feature-flag and canary. Alternative: hold in merge-queue and promote at off-peak. Also, consider a lightweight rollback test post-canary. :thumbsup:

alex: Operational plan:
- 17:25 PT: maria posts review summary
- 17:30 PT: cheng runs smoke & perf check
- By 17:50 PT: need 2x LGTM to merge + start canary
- If only 1x LGTM -> hold PR and target rollforward at 20:00 with db-guard on
If you are available for confirmation, reply `ack`. Otherwise reply `hold` if you see a regression.

samira: ack — I can swap in as backup approver at 17:40 PT if required.

maria: ack — finishing review now. No major comments so far. Leaving one nit and a runtime assert to change; should be done in 5–10m.

cheng: smoke passed on my infra; perf delta +0.3% on tail, looks fine. Will leave LGTM unless maria sees something major.

deploy-bot: Merge queue update: PR 9123 queued by alex. Required checks: ci/unit, ci/integration, canary-smoke. Currently: ci/unit ✅, ci/integration ⏳, canary-smoke ⏳. Estimated time to green ~12m.

jonah: Quick note on traffic: will throttle canary to 5% for first 10m then 25% for next 15m if all good. If any errors spike, auto-rollback will stop rollout.

alex: Thanks — will merge on two LGTM. If anyone types `hold` here I'll pause immediately. Otherwise plan is: gh pr merge 9123 --squash then trigger canary pipeline.

maria: LGTM (left the nit but not blocking).

cheng: LGTM

alex: Merging now.

deploy-bot: PR 9123 merged by alex. Canary rollout started (5% traffic). Monitoring: canary-errors=0, latency stable.

alex: Canary looks healthy at 5% after 8m. Scaling to 25%. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround.
